answer: Like mycelium weaving durable jade through dark soil, decentralized consensus anchors identity in tangled mutual endorsement. Each agent stakes transitive trust; a single malicious ripple cannot fool the wider fungal web. Because collective verification expands as a hypergraph across the network horizon, forging counterfeit personas incurs superlinear attacker cost: multiplying identities requires polynomial collateral, starving synthetic swarms before they breach consensus.
